components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary Cobalt action button used for creating projects, tasks, invoices, or saving inline forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; background: var(--accent, #2563eb); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #1d4ed8); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #1d4ed8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Crisp hairline secondary button for exports, filters, and cancel actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-primary, #111827); background: var(--bg-canvas, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cbd1da); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle, #f7f8fa); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Single-line hairline form input with high-contrast label alignment and focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-secondary, #4b5563); } .ds-field-input { height: 34px; padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-primary, #111827); background: var(--bg-canvas, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cbd1da); border-radius: 6px; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Square Badge
components.description: Localized semantic status badge pairing an 8px square indicator with compact AA-contrast text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 7px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-text, #1d4ed8); background: var(--accent-soft, #eff6ff); border: 1px solid var(--accent-border, #bfdbfe); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-status-sq { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent, #2563eb); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Sidebar Route Item
components.description: Compact workspace navigation item supporting subtle hover and active Cool-Zinc wash states.

narrative.overview:
ClientHub is a calm, high-density agency workspace designed so admins can track projects, tasks, client payments, expenses, and inquiries without visual noise. Rather than stacking floating cards with heavy drop shadows, the interface frames data inside crisp 1px structural hairlines against a quiet cool-neutral ground, keeping operational figures and task states legible at a glance.

The system pairs tight workspace density with restrained color discipline. Cool-Zinc neutrals establish three clear surface planes across Light and Dark modes—outer chrome, navigation sidebar, and main canvas—while a single Swiss Cobalt accent signals active controls, focus rings, and current navigation routes. Semantic hues (amber, green, red, neutral gray) appear strictly inside small square status indicators and WCAG AA badges rather than full-card decorations.

Every surface—the admin shell, client portal, and public contact intake form—shares the same geometric clarity: tabular numerals for currency and counts, inline editing flows without unnecessary modal detours, and geometric monogram initials in place of stock photography.
keyCharacteristics: Flat-by-default surfaces separated by 1px Cool-Zinc hairlines (--border) rather than drop shadows.
Three-tier workspace layering (--bg-chrome -> --bg-sidebar -> --bg-canvas) with explicit html.dark parity.
Single Swiss Cobalt primary accent paired with 8px square status indicators (status-sq) and restrained semantic badges.
Compact, high-legibility Public Sans typography with tabular-nums alignment on all financial and workload metrics.
Inline editing and zero decorative clutter across admin, client portal, and public intake surfaces.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Swiss Cobalt is reserved for primary actions, active route emphasis, focus rings, and data highlights; cards, headers, and containers never carry decorative colored top borders or gradient banners.

rules.name: The Localized Semantics Rule
rules.body: Status colors live exclusively inside 8px square indicators (status-sq), compact badges, and chart legends—never as full-row or full-card background washes.

rules.name: The Sequential Heading Rule
rules.body: Pages enforce strict h1 -> h2 -> h3 hierarchy with zero skipped heading levels so assistive navigation and scannable layout hierarchy stay predictable.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Rested workspace cards, list containers, and portal sections carry zero box-shadow; elevation is reserved exclusively for transient floating popovers, command palettes, and modal dialogs.

dos: Do enforce tabular-nums on every price, balance, task total, and timeline date across admin and portal views.
Do separate adjacent containers using 1px solid var(--border) hairlines and surface value steps (--bg-chrome vs --bg-canvas) rather than shadow depth.
Do preserve html.dark parity across all custom inputs, <select> options, Chart.js canvas labels, and semantic badges.
Do use visible <label for> bindings and keyboard-accessible <a> / <button> semantics for every interactive element.
Do use geometric CH monogram badges and single/two-letter initial avatars everywhere an identity mark is needed.
donts: Don't add drop shadows (shadow-sm / shadow-lg), gradient header banners, or rounded-2xl / 16px+ radii to workspace cards or Kanban boards.
Don't add decorative colored top borders (border-t-4) or saturated full-row washes to indicate status.
Don't replace real or zeroed metrics with placeholder testimonials, stock photography, or pulsing status dots (animate-pulse).
Don't leave inline click handlers on <div> / <td> without native <a> or <button> semantics.
